summary: @servicetitan/dte-unlayer preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: The package's preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases and then uses that runtime to execute `math_init.js`, a 727KB heavily-obfuscated sibling file at the tarball root (obfuscator.io-style rotated string/constant array with `_0x...` identifiers, a `WV8StW` rotation function, and a `hc1jfK9` string decoder). The package advertises itself as an email-editor wrapper for Unlayer and has no functional need for a second language runtime or a large opaque helper. `math_init.js` is also not covered by `package.json` `files: ["dist","src"]`, so the executed artifact is smuggled outside the declared manifest — a shape consistent with a compromised or attacker-assembled publish. Using an alternate (non-Node) runtime specifically evades Node-based install-time scanners; the actual behavior of the decoded payload runs on every `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
